mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 8.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, which increases corporate hiring and wage pressures, leading to higher earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 8.0%, or the average 20-day return is not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in residential construction starts above 960,000 units signals rising consumer confidence and housing market strength, which boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 960.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the mean return is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% combined with rising CPI inflation above 2.5% per year signals an accommodative monetary policy stance under inflationary pressure, which increases equity risk appetite and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.25 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 98.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 98.0, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both personal consumption expenditures (PAYEMS) and real personal income (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which increases corporate sales and profit visibility, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS and RSAFS both rise, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% within a 3-month window signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS increases > 0.3pp in 3 months, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the mean return is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 13,600 billion chained dollars signals a contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenues and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 13600.0, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate combined with stagnant job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.1%) signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS growth < 0.1%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
